newsitem.title: USA: Coke to record $320 mln non-cash Q3 benefit.
newsitem.headline: Coke to record $320 mln non-cash Q3 benefit.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said Friday it would record a $320 million non-recurring, non-cash benefit in the third quarter after reaching agreement in principle with the U.S. Internal Revenue Service on a number of issues dating back to 1981.
Coke said the accounting benefit arose because, under the agreement, accruals that had been recorded for taxes would be reduced.
It said the agreement ended negotiations it has had with the tax-collection agencty over issues including litigation involving its operations in Puerto Rico.
